name: button
title: Button (StellifyIT)
description: Shadcn-compatible button: primary (brand) / secondary (tonal) / base (no fill) + destructive/success/warning/info/link, no borders or shadows. `loading` shows the Spinner; CRUD `mode` (create/edit/finish) injects color and icon. default/lg/icon are 44px on touch screens. Overwrites ui/button.
